title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
summary: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
body: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于人工智能如何扩展职场工作内容的新研究。报告显示，ChatGPT用户在各种岗位上承担了更加广泛的任务，正在逐步重塑传统的岗位职责边界，体现了AI在实际生产力中的落地与演进。原始信息显示：New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How AI is expanding what people do at work”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI的研究展示了ChatGPT用户在实际工作中如何扩展任务边界与重塑岗位分工。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
